facts.fact: Bank of the Republic of Burundi launched the national instant payments platform BurundiPay, unveiled on 23 April 2026, connecting banks, microfinance institutions and mobile money networks.

systems.owner: Bank of the Republic of Burundi

BDI.note: No consumer-protection rule or redress stated.
No government payment to people stated.
No survey share of adults; only a projection of 78% using digital payments by 2040.

facts.fact: BurundiPay lets users transfer funds across banks, microfinance institutions and mobile money networks, using bank accounts, wallets or phone numbers, per the central bank governor.
The central bank launched BurundiPay as a national instant payments platform connecting banks, microfinance and mobile money networks, handling up to 1,000 transactions a second.

systems.owner: Bank of the Republic of Burundi

BDI.note: No tax or fee payment stated.
